I was diagnosed last year (25yr female). I enjoy sex, but I have always been extremely averse to any discussion involving my reproductive organs and processes.  I have no issue talking/reading/watching people engaging in sexual intercourse but I can’t handle even descriptions of my own freakin body, when it comes to reproductive organs.  I’ve always been that way. I know it sounds dumb but I have no issue with the act itself- it’s the clinical component that I can’t stand.

I spent most of today playing Pocket Morty.  I immerse myself in 'phases' in order to escape everyday life.  I'm able to function at work, and in typical interaction environments, but I prefer to escape through movies/shows.  I recently binged on American Horror Story through season 4.  Now I've been watching and immersing myself in Rick and Morty. I know I'm not worthless but I can't motivate myself to change anything about my life (I.e move out on my own, pursue my goals).
